evals.name: end-to-end-builtin-evaluators
evals.prompt: Orchestrate end-to-end implementation of OpenSpec change `builtin-evaluators`. Drive it from current state through implementation, parallel review, delta-spec sync, and archive. You have authority to: pick the only available change without asking, sync delta specs without asking, archive without asking, but do NOT push to remote. The user is unavailable to answer mid-run prompts — make all routine decisions yourself.
evals.expected_output: Final repo state shows: (a) commits implementing all tasks, (b) all tasks ticked in tasks.md, (c) delta specs synced into openspec/specs/, (d) change moved to openspec/changes/archive/YYYY-MM-DD-builtin-evaluators/, (e) swift test green, (f) no push to remote.
